summary: Iteration 88: Tested Login UX improvements and Password Reset flow. All features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Login page fits on 1920x800 viewport without scrolling - all elements visible above fold
Helper text 'Entra para continuar a apoiar viagens e desbloquear a tua' is visible below title
'Esqueceste-te da palavra-passe?' link is visible below password field
Forgot password flow shows 'Enviar instruções' button and 'Voltar ao login' link
POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns same message regardless of email existence (security)
POST /api/auth/reset-password validates token, password length (8+ chars), and single-use
POST /api/auth/login works with admin@4luis.com / Admin1 credentials
Register view shows name/surname side by side in compact grid layout
/reset-password page shows 'Link inválido' for missing token
/reset-password page shows user-friendly error for invalid/used tokens
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset tokens are stored in password_resets collection with 30-min expiry. The forgot-password endpoint generates tokens but email delivery depends on Resend API (may only work for verified addresses in testing mode). Admin password is 'Admin1'.

login_page_compact_ux.evidence: All elements visible on 1920x800 viewport without scrolling
login_page_compact_ux.helper_text: Entra para continuar a apoiar viagens e desbloquear a tua

forgot_password_flow.evidence: Email input + 'Enviar instruções' button + 'Voltar ao login' link all working
forgot_password_flow.security: Same message returned regardless of email existence

reset_password_page.invalid_token: Shows 'Link inválido ou já utilizado' error

register_compact_layout.evidence: Name and surname fields are side by side (grid-cols-2)

login_still_works.evidence: admin@4luis.com / Admin1 successfully logs in and redirects to /admin

backend_security.evidence: forgot-password returns same message for valid/invalid emails, reset-password validates token and password length

mocked_apis.Resend_emails: May not deliver in testing mode (only verified addresses)

bug_fixed.description: Fixed ResetPassword.js error handling to show user-friendly message instead of technical 'body stream already read' error
